evidence.title: Artboard Studio ⎯ Online Mockup Generator & Editor for Designers

name: Artboard Studio
summary: Online mockup generator and editor with 5,000+ device, apparel, packaging, print and branding mockups, plus Figma plugins.
description: An online mockup generator and editor: place images or videos on 5,000+ realistic mockups across devices, apparel, packaging, print and branding, then export PNG, JPEG, WEBP or MP4/WEBM video. Works in the browser or through the Figma and Adobe Express plugins, with an AI generator that turns a text prompt into a mockup. Free plan; Lite $9/mo, Pro $19/mo billed annually, or $129 lifetime.
contains: 5,000+ mockups across devices, apparel, packaging, print and branding
browser editor plus Figma and Adobe Express plugins
export PNG, JPEG, WEBP images and MP4/WEBM video mockups
AI mockup generator turns a text prompt into a mockup
free plan; Lite $9/mo and Pro $19/mo billed annually; Lifetime $129 one-time
all mockups include a commercial license
categories include iPhone, laptop, t-shirt, bottle, poster, billboard, mug
